run_bm_pulsar: run the PULSAR forward and backward rendering benchmarks on CUDA with 1 million points
test_bm_pulsar_forward: test the PULSAR forward rendering benchmark using Renderer with random vertex positions and colors
test_bm_pulsar_backward: test the PULSAR backward pass benchmark by computing gradients on the renderer output
review_Renderer_forward: review the PULSAR Renderer forward pass with vertex positions, colors, radii, and camera parameters
benchmark_bm_pulsar: benchmark the PULSAR renderer forward and backward passes using fvcore with warmup iterations
